decision.reason: The release note [ev-a7b3f6c5d3bd] says only "remove unused option" and doesn't say which option it is or what kind it is (CLI flag, env var, Helm value or config key). It also doesn't say whether environments that still set the option will fail, get a rejection or have it ignored. None of the other Bug Fixes items in the section describe this change; [ev-1e1395778114] mentions a webhook disable option, but it's a separate change and doesn't identify the option removed here. We need the content of PR #6557 (the diff or its description) to pin down the subject, how it changed, who is exposed and the consequence.
